tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITION AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The firm or agency must have at least 3 years of service experience in providing manpower services. Certified certificates issued by organizations/departments in this regard must be attached.

Bidders must be financially sound. A Solvency / Line of Credit certificate of 19.30 Lakhs obtained in the name of "District Project Co-ordinator, Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan, Gadag" must be properly submitted

Income tax return filing documents for the last three financial years 2022 23 2023 24 2024 25 under the Income Tax Act must be attached. A photocopy of the PAN card in the name of the organization must also be enclosed

Annual turnover certificates Audited Reports, Profit and Loss Account Balance Sheetetc for the last 3 financial years 2022 23 2023 24 2024 25 certified by an officially registered Chartered Accountant must be attached

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A certificate issued by a registered Chartered Accountant confirming that the tenderer has an average annual turnover of at least 90 00 Lakhs over the last 3 financial years 2022 23 202324 2024 5 must be attached.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Participating agencies, firms, or societies must be registered under government rules Labour Department Registration Stamps Department). Registration certificate and renewal certificate issued by the Labour Department under Form C Rule 4must be attached
Must possess GST registration. A No Dues Certificate obtained from the competent authority regarding payment of GST taxes for the last three financial years 2022 23 202324 2024 2 must be attached.
Must possess ESI registration. A No Dues Certificate obtained from the competent authority regarding the payment of ESI installments for the last 2 financial years (2023 24 2024 25) must be attached.
Must possess EPF registration. A No Dues Certificate obtained from the competent authority regarding the payment of EPF installments for the last 2 financial years (2023 24 2024 25) must be attached.

Must possess Professional Tax registration. A No Dues Certificate obtained from the competent authority regarding the payment of Professional Tax for the last 2 financial years (2023 24 2024 25) must be attached.
A notarized affidavit stating that the organization/agency has not been blacklisted by the Education Department or any other government department or organization must be submitted
